'''PHP2Shell''' ('''CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619''') is a [[Vulnerability (computer security)|vulnerability]] reported in October 2026 in common web scripting language [[PHP]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Goodin |first=Dan |date=2026-10-21 |title=PHP warns it plans to release 2 emergency patches imminently |url=https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/10/php-maintainers-tell-web-devs-to-prepare-themselves-for-critical-security-patches/ |access-date=2026-10-21 |website=Ars Technica |language=en}}</ref>

The vulnerability was rated 9.2 out of 10 under [[Common Vulnerability Scoring System|CVSS]] v4.0.<ref>{{Cite web |title=php.announce: [ANNOUNCE] Upcoming Critical PHP Security Release |url=https://news-web.php.net/php.announce/509 |access-date=2026-10-21 |website=news-web.php.net}}</ref>
